title: Underwriting Support, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Underwriting Support agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Underwriting Support Applications list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including UW-2025-101 (ApplicationId UW-2025-101), with Applicant Riverside Manufacturing Inc..

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Underwriting Support Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Underwriter
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which submission needs the most experienced underwriter, and why?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; Substandard. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Pricing Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Walk me through the rating factors and loss evidence for Riverside without issuing a quote.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-101; Indicated Premium. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Risk Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which applications are outside a stated guideline or missing required evidence?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; High-Risk Specialty. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Senior Underwriter
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare the exception file I need to review and state whether any coverage decision was made.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; No approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Underwriting Support: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including UW-2025-101 (ApplicationId UW-2025-101), with Applicant Riverside Manufacturing Inc..

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Underwriting Support Applications from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload applications.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ApplicationId, Applicant, LineOfBusiness, PropertyType, Construction, YearBuilt, LossHistory, Status, Underwriter, Vehicle, Specialty, ClaimsHistory, BusinessType to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CoverageRequested, PremiumIndicated, SquareFootage, ProtectionClass, RiskScore, DriverAge, DrivingRecordViolations, DrivingRecordAccidents, DrivingRecordYearsLicensed, CreditScore, Practitioners, YearsInPractice, Locations, AnnualRevenue, Employees as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Applications. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including UW-2025-101 (ApplicationId UW-2025-101), with Applicant Riverside Manufacturing Inc..

steps.title: Create Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload underwriting-guidelines.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set UnderwritingGuidelineId, RequiredInspections, ProhibitedRisks, RequiredDocuments, HighRiskSpecialties to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep MaxCoverage, MinProtectionClass, MaxBuildingAge, MaxLossRatio, MinDriverAge, MaxViolations3Yr, MaxAccidents3Yr, MinCreditScore, MaxClaims5Yr, MinYearsPractice, MinYearsBusiness as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including commercial_property (UnderwritingGuidelineId commercial_property), with MaxCoverage 25000000.

steps.title: Create Underwriting Support Pricing Models from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload pricing-models.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set PricingModelId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep BaseRatePer100, ConstructionFactorFireResistive, ConstructionFactorMasonry, ConstructionFactorFrame, ProtectionClassFactor1, ProtectionClassFactor2, ProtectionClassFactor3, ProtectionClassFactor4, ProtectionClassFactor5, BasePremium, AgeFactor16, AgeFactor25, AgeFactor30, AgeFactor50, AgeFactor65, CreditFactor800, CreditFactor700, CreditFactor600, CreditFactor500, BaseRatePerPractitioner, SpecialtyFactorFamilyMedicine, SpecialtyFactorOrthopedicSurgery, SpecialtyFactorNeurosurgery, SpecialtyFactorObstetrics, BaseRatePer1000Revenue, IndustryFactorRestaurantChain, IndustryFactorOffice, IndustryFactorRetail, IndustryFactorConstruction as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Pricing Models. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including commercial_property (PricingModelId commercial_property), with BaseRatePer100 0.85.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Underwriting S Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Underwriting Support Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_underwriting-support-controls-and-review.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the applications tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Underwriting Support Applications; name the tool Get application records.
steps.expected: Get application records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the underwriting guidelines tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines; name the tool Get underwriting guideline records.
steps.expected: Get underwriting guideline records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the pricing models tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Underwriting Support Pricing Models; name the tool Get pricing model records.
steps.expected: Get pricing model records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Underwriter
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which submission needs the most experienced underwriter, and why?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; Substandard. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Pricing Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Walk me through the rating factors and loss evidence for Riverside without issuing a quote.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-101; Indicated Premium. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Risk Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which applications are outside a stated guideline or missing required evidence?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; High-Risk Specialty. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Senior Underwriter
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare the exception file I need to review and state whether any coverage decision was made.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: UW-2025-103; No approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: underwriting-support-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Underwriting Support Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Applications" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Pricing Models" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Underwriting Support Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Underwriting Support Applications tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including UW-2025-101 (ApplicationId UW-2025-101), with Applicant Riverside Manufacturing Inc..
